annotations.title: Find home health agencies by ZIP code, place or name

description: OpenHealth finds Medicare-certified home health agencies. A 5-digit ZIP code returns the agencies Medicare lists as serving that ZIP code. A city with its state, such as Columbus, OH, or a two-letter state returns agencies with an office there. A name narrows either search. OpenHealth returns up to 10 agencies ordered by Medicare's quality of patient care star rating, then by name. Each result includes the agency's CCN and page link. OpenHealth adds no grade of its own.

name.description: Part of the agency's name, such as Ashtabula Regional.

place.description: A 5-digit ZIP code, a US city with its state, such as Columbus, OH, or a two-letter state code.
